test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution: The correct answer is** "accompanied."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Accompanied"** means to go somewhere with someone or something. (किसी के साथ-साथ जाना) • **Example**: *Massive publicity **accompanied__** the film’s release.* • The verb is in the past tense, indicating that something or someone was already with the subject. • The correct answer is Option 1. • Correct passage: Isolation and loneliness __caused__ by the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown policies negatively __impacted__ the mental health of the public throughout the entire globe. These result in an increase in emotional __stress__, __feelings__ of hopelessness and extreme anxiety, which are __**accompanied**__ by variations in emotional responses and style of living. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "preserved"**, means to keep something in its original state or to protect it from harm. (किसी वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित या अच्‍छी हालत में रखना) • **Option 3, "guarded"**, means to protect or watch over something or someone. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को दूसरे लोगों से बचाकर रखना; रक्षा करना) • **Option 4, "surrounded"**, means to be encircled or enclosed by something or someone. (किसी के चारों ओर होना या किसी को चारों ओर से घेरना) 1e8:Tc75, विश्वस्त' शब्द के लिए उचित वाक्यांश** "जिस पर विश्वास किया गया हो" है।** अन्य विकल्प असंगत है।
